source: This is misrepresentation of what I said. I never claimed to invent the internet, I was merely pointing out that government research which I supported as a Senator was a crucial piece of the equation.
zh: 这是对我所说内容的歪曲。我从未声称发明了互联网，我只是指出我作为参议员支持的政府研究是其中的关键部分。

source: This is a petty, personal attack, designed to distract from the real issues facing our country.
zh: 这是一次微不足道的人身攻击，旨在分散人们对我们国家面临的真正问题的注意力。

source: Bob Graham has served his home state of Florida well. He has fought tirelessly for education and the environment.
zh: 鲍勃·格雷厄姆很好地服务了他的家乡佛罗里达州。他为教育和环境不懈奋斗。

source: Bob Graham has served his home state of Florida well. He is the type of independent thinker we need in the White House.
zh: 鲍勃·格雷厄姆很好地服务了他的家乡佛罗里达州。他是我们白宫中需要的那种独立思考者。

source: It does not help your stature to be attacking a third-party candidate like Ralph Nader.
zh: 攻击像拉尔夫·纳德这样的第三方候选人对你的地位没有任何帮助。

source: This is probably a good approach.
zh: 这可能是一个好方法。

source: Today you have announced the selection of John Kerry as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 今天您宣布选择约翰·克里作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: John Kerry is the type of principled, liberal thinker we need in our administration. He has worked tirelessly on behalf of all Americans.
zh:
约翰·克里是我们的政府需要的那种有原则、自由的思想家。他为所有美国人不懈地努力。
然而，

source: John Kerry is the best person for the job. He has proven his ability time and time again over his years in the Senate.
zh: 约翰·克里是这项工作的最佳人选。在参议院任职期间，他一次又一次证明了自己的能力。

source: Today you have announced the selection of Evan Bayh as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 今天您宣布选择埃文·贝赫作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: Evan Bayh is the best person for the job. He has proven his ability time and time again as a Governor and Senator.
zh: 埃文·贝赫是这项工作的最佳人选。作为州长和参议员，他一次又一次证明了自己的能力。

source: Evan Bayh has served his home state of Indiana well. He is an independent thinker who consistently seeks bipartisan solutions.
zh: 埃文·贝赫很好地服务了他的家乡印第安纳州。他是一位独立的思想家，始终寻求两党合作的解决方案。

source: The most important priority is to prevent the election of George W. Bush to President. I will not put my name on the ballot in any contested state. I expect that people in other places will see that a vote for me symbolizes a vote for a new kind of politics in the long term.
zh: 最重要的优先事项是阻止乔治·W.·布什当选总统。在任何有争议的州，我不会把我的名字写在选票上。我希望其他地方的人们会看到，从长远来看，投票给我象征着投票给一种新型政治。

source: The two parties are almost the same on every major issue. Neither supports meaningful campaign finance reform, universal health care, free college education, a peaceful foreign policy, or the protection of American workers. I present a true alternative to the American people.
zh: 两党在每一个重大问题上几乎都是一致的。两者都不支持有意义的竞选财务改革、全民医疗保健、免费大学教育、和平外交政策或保护美国工人。我向美国人民提出了一个真正的选择。

source: If victory for the left means eight years of Bill Clinton and a term for Al Gore, then it is a shallow victory indeed. Bill Clinton has pushed cherished Republican proposals like NAFTA and welfare reform to fruition. I will end this betrayal of the American worker.
zh: 如果左派的胜利意味着八年的比尔·克林顿和阿尔·戈尔的任期，那么这确实是一次肤浅的胜利。比尔·克林顿推动了诸如北美自由贸易协定等备受珍视的共和党提案和福利改革的成果。我将结束这种对美国工人的背叛。

source: I am the true choice for Americans concerned about the environment and Social Security. I will enact strict regulation of the oil and coal industry, fight against big agriculture and GMO's, and support research and subsidies for alternative energy. I will increase funding and benefits for Social Security.
zh: 我是关心环境的美国人的真正选择社会保障。我将对石油和煤炭行业实施严格监管，打击大农业和转基因生物，并支持替代能源的研究和补贴。我将增加社会保障的资金和福利。

source: We will run a national campaign and gather as many votes as possible towards our goal of becoming a viable third-party. I will tell liberal Americans to resist the urge to vote for Al Gore, by reminding them of the many ways in which he does not differ from Republicans.
zh: 我们将开展一场全国性的竞选活动，并收集尽可能多的选票，以实现成为可行的第三方的目标。我将提醒自由派美国人，提醒他们他与共和党人在许多方面没有什么不同，从而抵制投票给阿尔·戈尔的冲动。

source: The best way to gather votes is to run up our totals in liberal states like New York, Massachusetts, and California. We will focus on these areas heavily.
zh: 收集选票的最佳方法是增加纽约州、马萨诸塞州和加利福尼亚州等自由主义州的总数。我们将重点关注这些领域。

source: I will focus extensively on how Republicans and Democrats alike have betrayed the American worker through trade agreements like NAFTA and a lack of protection for American industry. My campaign will focus on opponents of globalization who have no one else to vote for.
zh: 我将广泛关注共和党和民主党如何通过北美自由贸易协定等贸易协定以及对美国工业缺乏保护来背叛美国工人。我的竞选活动将把重点放在全球化的反对者身上，因为他们没有其他人可以投票。

source: I will focus extensively on how Republicans and Democrats alike have betrayed the American environment. I will hammer on the themes of carbon emissions, GMO crops, giveaways to corporations, and other areas where both parties have failed the American people.
zh: 我将广泛关注共和党人和民主党人如何背叛美国环境。我将重点讨论碳排放、转基因作物、向企业提供赠品以及双方都令美国人民失望的其他领域的主题。

source: Let's give a good speech about the need for big changes to American politics and society. I will remind voters that the Democrats and Republicans are two sides of the same corporate policies, and attack Al Gore's pretensions to stand for the American worker.
zh: 让我们就美国政治和社会进行重大变革的必要性发表一篇精彩的演讲。我会提醒选民，民主党和共和党是同一公司政策的两个方面，并攻击阿尔·戈尔自称代表美国工人的行为。

source: Let's talk about how we are allowing large corporations to ruin the American environment for their own profits, while everyday people suffer from pollution, unclean water, and a dangerous lack of regulation on food and prescription drugs.
zh: 让我们谈谈我们如何允许大公司为了自身利益而破坏美国的环境，而普通人却遭受着污染、不干净的水以及对食品和处方药缺乏监管的危险。

source: Let's emphasize that both Democrats and Republicans have sold out the American worker to the interests of corporations. I will remind people of NAFTA, the WTO protests, and other decisions that have decimated American manufacturing.
zh: 让我们强调一下，民主党人和共和党人都为了企业的利益而出卖了美国工人。我会提醒人们北美自由贸易协定、世贸组织的抗议以及其他摧毁美国制造业的决定。

source: I will attack George Bush relentlessly. I will expose Bush as a phony and an elitist, corporatist conservative and not as the moderate that he presents himself as.
zh: 我会毫不留情地攻击乔治·布什。我将揭露布什是一个虚伪的精英主义者、社团主义保守派，而不是他所表现的温和派。

source: I will visit states like Ohio, Michigan, and Pennsylvania that have been especially hard hit by global trade agreements and the outsourcing of manufacturing jobs.
zh: 我将访问俄亥俄州、密歇根州和宾夕法尼亚州等州，这些州受到全球贸易协定和制造业工作外包的打击尤其严重。

source: The last few days will be business as usual. My goal is to bring my message to all parts of America, whether it be in close states or those that clearly tilt towards one of the main candidates.
zh: 最后几天一切如常。我的目标是将我的信息传达给美国各地，无论是在关系密切的州还是那些明显倾向于主要候选人之一的州。

source: I will hold massive rallies in New York and try to run up my vote total in the left-leaning, uncontested states of that region. People should not be afraid to vote for me.
zh: 我将在纽约州举行大规模集会，并尝试在该地区左倾、无争议的州增加我的选票总数。人们不应该害怕投票给我。

source: This is the type of non-issue that is indicative of the broken American political system. George Bush was wrong for America before this news broke, and he is still wrong for America.
zh: 这是一种非问题类型，表明美国政治体系已支离破碎。在这个消息传出之前，乔治·布什对美国来说是错误的，而且他对美国来说仍然是错误的。

source: Interesting campaign strategy. But you will lose a good number of votes in states like Florida and Ohio, and every little bit helps if you want to hit 5% nationally.
zh: 有趣的竞选策略。但在佛罗里达州和俄亥俄州等州，您将失去大量选票，如果您想在全国范围内达到 5%，那么每一点选票都会有所帮助。

source: This is one of the big decisions of your campaign -- will people turn out to vote for you in close states? Time will tell.
zh: 这是您竞选活动中的重大决定之一 - 人们会在相近的州投票给您吗？时间会证明一切。

source: This is one of the big decisions of your campaign -- can you run up your vote total in large, liberal states to hit the 5% threshold nationally? Time will tell.
zh: 这是您竞选活动中的重大决定之一 - 您能否在大型自由州增加您的选票总数，以达到全国范围内 5% 的门槛？时间会证明一切。

source: There might be a market for anti-globalization views in these states, but they also might be very close on election night. Will left-wing voters risk a vote on you instead of Gore?
zh: 这些州可能存在反全球化观点的市场，但它们在选举之夜也可能非常接近。左翼选民会冒险投票给你而不是戈尔吗？

source: There's nothing wrong with sticking to the usual program.
zh: 坚持通常的计划并没有什么问题。

source: You give a passionate speech to 20,000 screaming supporters on the Saturday before the election. Will it help?
zh: 您在选举前的周六向 20,000 名尖叫的支持者发表了热情洋溢的演讲。有帮助吗？

source: Regardless of the recent news, it looks like Bush has received a solid bounce heading into election night. But you might get a few more votes if Gore looks to be losing.
zh: 不管最近的消息如何，看起来布什在选举之夜已经获得了强劲的反弹。但如果戈尔看起来会失败，您可能会获得更多选票。

source: It doesn't seem like this revelation has changed much. If the election is close, some voters might jump to Gore instead of you.
zh: 这个启示似乎没有太大改变。如果选举结果接近，一些选民可能会跳到戈尔而不是您。

source: It looks like Gore has received a solid bounce heading into election night. This might help you pick up a few wavering votes.
zh: 看起来戈尔在选举之夜已经获得了强劲的反弹。这可能会帮助你赢得一些摇摆不定的选票。
